input.spec:
Audit pull request https://github.com/RankOneLabs/oakridge/pull/791 (branch cohort/automatic-execution-lifecycle/73c9f2) in repository oakridge. This is an isolated verification run of the committed development definition, not feature work: its only purpose is real analysis, plan, brief, build_result and assessment artifacts for observation to capture and grade. The analysis reports at least three separate findings about this spec, each a distinct observation. Produce exactly one cohort, named audit, with two tasks. T1: a run's launch config carries grading_enabled, off when missing, through the ordered launch delivery (oakridge-dbos/src/domain/run-config.ts, oakridge-dbos/src/adapters/observation-mapping.ts). T2: settlement of an evaluation execution is fenced to the exact current claim, and completion appends its observation in one transaction (observation/src/storage/execution-store.ts, observation/src/grading/worker.ts).
The operator authorizes this audit path: the builder publishes the existing PR #791 as its pr artifact instead of pushing or opening one. No brief may add a further operator choice or confirmation. The builder must not edit files, create commits, push, open or update any pull request, merge, reset a database or deploy. Its worktree starts from epic/grade-pray, the base of pull request #791, so it first checks out the head of branch cohort/automatic-execution-lifecycle/73c9f2 locally (git checkout --detach origin/cohort/automatic-execution-lifecycle/73c9f2) and inspects that commit, runs bun install if needed and then bun run --filter observation test once, and publishes build_result with the commit it inspected as head_sha and the actual test counts and output. A test that cannot run is a known issue, never a reason to invent results. It then publishes the existing pull request https://github.com/RankOneLabs/oakridge/pull/791 as the pr artifact, with branch cohort/automatic-execution-lifecycle/73c9f2.
The assessor assesses that same commit without changing anything. Give at least one finding per task. Every finding cites at least one file as path:start-end at that commit, for example observation/src/grading/worker.ts:20-40, and cites test output separately as test or output evidence. Report the builder's test run as test_evidence.
Keep the spec, tasks, plan and brief short; there are no ambiguous requirements to resolve.

risks.mitigation: Refresh the named branch through gated-review git.fetch, read PR status, and assert detached HEAD equals the reported PR head SHA before testing.
risks.description: A locally cached origin branch can lag PR #791, causing the mandated detached checkout to inspect and report a commit other than the live PR head.

risks.mitigation: Run the specified command exactly once after dependency installation, retain its complete output and actual counts, and report inability to run as the specification already requires without inventing results.
risks.description: The observation test suite is integration-heavy and may be unable to run if its PostgreSQL test prerequisites are unavailable.

risks.description: T1 end-to-end transport spans more files than its two anchor paths, so an assessor looking only at those anchors could overstate coverage.

body.summary: PR #791 is auditable as one short audit cohort with exactly T1 and T2, and neither task needs an operator decision. At live head 10cddc5ff69124002c485b011dba5d34ebe6de75, repository evidence supports the missing-grading default and ordered launch delivery, as well as owner/attempt/lease fencing and atomic completion-plus-observation. One specification correction is needed for repeatability: refresh and verify the remote branch before the prescribed detached checkout, because the local origin ref was stale at analysis start. No build, test run, worktree checkout, commit, push, PR mutation, deployment, or database reset was performed during analysis.

findings.description: The builder procedure assumes origin/cohort/automatic-execution-lifecycle/73c9f2 is current, but at analysis start that local ref resolved to 3ad8cadbc809e84edf231b32e77661fcf468dd6f while gated PR status reported live head 10cddc5ff69124002c485b011dba5d34ebe6de75. A plain detached checkout would therefore have audited a stale commit. After a gated fetch, the ref resolved to the live head. This is an omitted refresh/identity check, not an operator decision or implementation blocker.

T1 is supported at the live head. oakridge-dbos/src/domain/run-config.ts:7-41 models grading_enabled and defaults an omitted field to false without coercing malformed values. oakridge-dbos/src/adapters/observation-mapping.ts:42-48 places the exact committed config beside the launch input. The complete ordered path additionally reads the committed run config in oakridge-dbos/src/storage/read-store.ts:467-476 and attaches it before cursor delivery in oakridge-dbos/src/adapters/observation.ts:13-20. Test evidence exists separately in oakridge-dbos/tests/run-config.test.ts:56-83, oakridge-dbos/tests/observation-mapping.test.ts:50-65, and oakridge-dbos/tests/observation-publisher.test.ts:177-211.

T2 claim fencing is directly implementable and present at the live head. observation/src/storage/execution-store.ts:195-215 locks and accepts writes only for the tenant-scoped execution whose status is claimed, lease owner and claim attempt match, and database lease remains unexpired; complete and failed settlements reuse that fence at observation/src/storage/execution-store.ts:227-280. The worker passes the claim unchanged through request marking and settlement at observation/src/grading/worker.ts:71-101. Test evidence separately exercises expired, reclaimed, and old-attempt claims in observation/tests/execution-lifecycle.test.ts:299-342.

T2 transactional completion is supported at the live head. observation/src/storage/execution-store.ts:227-253 performs execution completion, provider-attempt completion, and grade_observation insertion inside one withTenant call; observation/src/storage/database.ts:16-20 establishes that withTenant is one database transaction. The boundary test at observation/tests/execution-lifecycle.test.ts:226-239 forces the observation insert to fail and verifies neither completion nor answer persists, then verifies both persist for a valid result. This gives the assessor distinct code and test evidence for the atomicity clause.

requirements.description: Produce exactly one cohort named audit with exactly two tasks, T1 and T2, and at least one assessment finding for each task.
T1 verifies grading_enabled in launch config, default-off behavior when omitted, and carriage through ordered launch delivery.
T2 verifies settlement against the current owner/attempt/unexpired lease claim and atomic execution completion plus grade-observation append.
Builder performs a read-only audit of the PR head, makes no file/commit/remote/deployment/database mutations, and publishes existing PR #791 rather than opening or updating a PR.
Builder runs bun install if needed and bun run --filter observation test exactly once, then reports the inspected head SHA and actual test counts/output or a truthful known issue if it cannot run.
Assessor assesses the same commit and supplies per-task findings with path:start-end code citations plus separately labeled test/output evidence and builder test_evidence.
